findings.title: revenueDelta is not exhaustive and silently returns 0 for paused plans
findings.why_it_matters: The 'paused' variant falls through to `return 0`, so paused plans quietly contribute nothing to revenue and no test or compiler error will catch it. Unlike describe(), this switch has no never-guard, so future variants will be dropped too.
findings.suggested_fix: Handle 'paused' explicitly and end with `default: return assertNever(event)`.
